findings.title: Resolve donor-local nested evidence through authenticated replicas

sites.actual_donor: the corresponding fixed predecessor donor from release.donors

findings.problem: Both source-emitted references contain original donor-directory paths. Raw c.binding resolves them in the collection phase without applying replica_directory_relative. A valid authenticated replica under a different directory is rejected, or the code observes a separate original-path file rather than that replica.
findings.required_repair: Use c.donor_binding for the current donor launch intent; find the matching predetermined predecessor family/block donor and use c.donor_binding for its BLOCK_FREEZE reference. Preserve source-fixed original path and SHA joins with each selected donor.
findings.effect: Blocks reliable full39 metadata collection; scientific configuration and disabled state are unaffected.
findings.status: unresolved in sealed V1; fresh V2 repair required
